statement: Every key a deployment writes to Redis lives under its one `cosec.key-prefix`: snapshot documents, control-plane records, candidates, shadow reports, revocations, memberships, API keys, rate limit counters and OAuth states. Two deployments on one Redis that differ in it share no key. An environment that sets one of the three prefixes it replaced fails startup as a key CoSec does not read, and no property turns that check off, so no revocation is left where nothing reads it. The prefix is letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-` only, never `:`, so that no deployment's prefix nests inside another's; any other prefix fails startup, naming what it holds (DR1-D-4).
